data: Deux couples, Pierre et Aimée, et Eric et Pénélope, partagent tous les quatre plusieurs années d'amitié sans nuage. Seul souci, Pénélope et Pierre sont devenus amants... La situation devenant intenable, ils décident de rompre. Mais après une ultime nuit d'amour passionnée, le sort leur joue un tour : Pierre et Pénélope se réveillent chacun dans le corps de l'autre ! Pour protéger leur secret, ils se retrouvent chacun à devoir vivre la vie de l'autre. C'est le début des complications... (For several years, two couples, Pierre and Aimée, and Eric and Pénélope, have enjoyed a warm and solid friendship. The only problem: Pénélope and Pierre have become lovers... The situation has become impossible and they decide to break up. But after a final passionate night of lovemaking, fate plays a trick on them: Pierre and Pénélope wake up in each other's bodies. To protect their secret, they are each obliged to live each other's life. Things are going to get complicated...)

For several years, two couples, Pierre and Aimée, and Eric and Pénélope, have enjoyed a warm and solid friendship. The only problem: Pénélope and Pierre have become lovers... The situation has become impossible and they decide to break up. But after a final passionate night of lovemaking, fate plays a trick on them: Pierre and Pénélope wake up in each other's bodies. To protect their secret, they are each obliged to live each other's life. Things are going to get complicated...
